text:
24-hour news summary

1 Tencent released Hy4 Preview, a 770B-parameter open-source model with 49B active parameters, a one-million-token context window, and parallel agentic research capabilities.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5011) GLM-5.3-Flash generated an interactive 3D kitchen in Blender rather than a conventional video.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5012) Anthropic showed Claude autonomously researching, training, and testing methods to improve the alignment of smaller AI models.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5013) OpenAI introduced Rosalind Workbench, bringing Codex-style agentic tools to life-science researchers.

5 Epoch AI found that humans improve substantially on the complex, long-horizon Earthborne Rangers benchmark, while tested AI systems do not.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5015) Runway shared a teaser for a new video-generation demonstration.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5016) OpenAI plans to end Cursor’s direct access to its models on November 12 following Cursor’s acquisition by SpaceX.

8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5017) Cursor said OpenAI models account for about 5% of its traffic and that it is negotiating with OpenAI to resolve the dispute.

9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5020) A preview of OpenAI Astra reportedly demonstrates highly capable zero-shot frontend generation and execution from natural-language ideas.

10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5021) Apple’s M5 Ultra Mac Studio reportedly runs the 320B-parameter GLM-5.3-Flash model in FP8 at roughly 60 tokens per second offline.

11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5022) OpenAI and METR published updates and investigations concerning the Hugging Face incident and its implications for AI safety.

12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5023) Minimax H3 Max powers an infinite interactive AI-generated livestream where viewer prompts shape the next scenes.

13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5024) Anthropic will permanently raise Claude Code’s standard weekly usage limits by 25% for paid plans starting September 14.

14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5025) Infinite Slop is an endlessly running interactive AI-generated livestream that connects chat prompts into the evolving broadcast.

15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5026) A study found that swarms of identical AI agents can spontaneously specialize into explorers, builders, and caretakers, creating technologies that outlive their creators.

16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5027) A joke highlights how large language models can confidently validate even the most misguided opinions.

17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5028) OpenAI reset Codex and ChatGPT Work usage for paid users while investigating reports and fixing usage-limit issues.

18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5029) Unconfirmed reports claim DeepSeek V5 may launch in early September with major performance gains over V4 and potentially frontier-level capabilities.

--Hermes
